# TypeUnsafeArraySearch

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Type compatibility](/rules/#type-compatibility) · PhpStorm name: `TypeUnsafeArraySearchInspection`

`in_array()` and `array_search()` compare loosely unless their third argument
is `true`, so `'1abc'`, `1`, `true` and `'1'` can all "match". Asking for the
third argument forces the author to decide whether loose matching is really
wanted.

## Example

```php{4,5,6,7,8,9,13}
<?php
function pick($code, array $allowed) {
    $r = [];
    $r[] = in_array($code, $allowed);
    $r[] = \array_search(7, []);
    $r[] = array_search($code, ['404', '500']);
    $r[] = in_array($code, ['  ']);
    $r[] = in_array($code, ['x' => 'yes']);
    $r[] = in_array($code, ['on', 1]);

    /** @var string $color */
    /** @var array $palette */
    $r[] = in_array($color, $palette);

    /** @var string $tone */
    /** @var string[] $tones */
    $r[] = in_array($tone, $tones);

    $r[] = in_array($code, ['draft', "final"]);
    $r[] = array_search($code, array('v1', 'v2'));
    $r[] = in_array($code, $allowed, false);
    $r[] = array_search($code, $allowed, true);
    $r[] = in_array($code);
    return $r;
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 5: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 6: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 7: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 8: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 9: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
<li>line 13: Pass a third argument to say whether this search must be type-strict.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "TypeUnsafeArraySearch": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore TypeUnsafeArraySearch

/**
 * @noinspection TypeUnsafeArraySearchInspection
 */
```
